tmalign.version: * TM-align (Version 20240303): protein and RNA structure alignment   *

status_definitions.supported_candidate: mapped, within cutoff, target atom role-compatible, no severe local/global clash
status_definitions.supported_consistent: supported_candidate in 3/3 models and no clash in any model
status_definitions.supported_majority: supported_candidate in 2/3 models and no clash in any model
status_definitions.supported_majority_with_model_clash: supported_candidate in 2/3 models but clash in the other model
status_definitions.model_dependent_supported: supported_candidate in exactly one model and no clash in any model
status_definitions.model_dependent_supported_with_clash: supported_candidate in exactly one model and clash in another model
status_definitions.geometric_only: mapped and within cutoff, but target atom role is not compatible
status_definitions.role_mismatch: no corresponding target atom/group for the source atom role
status_definitions.clash: local or global severe distance flag
status_definitions.not_recovered: mapped but the corresponding target atom distance exceeds the ligand-specific cutoff
status_definitions.uncertain_mapping: low geometry confidence; not used as support

audit.note: Distance thresholds are flags, not universal chemical clash judgments; no explicit hydrogens or protonation states.
